dashboard.bootstrapNodesHint: DHT bootstrap node addresses, one per line
dashboard.requesterRequestLimitHint: Global rate limit shared between metadata (TCP) and DHT (UDP) requests (0 = unlimited)
dashboard.dhtPortHint: DHT UDP listen port — Requires server restart to take effect
dashboard.responderGlobalRateLimitHint: Max incoming DHT queries per second (0 = unlimited)
dashboard.responderPerIPRateLimitHint: Max incoming DHT queries per second per IP (0 = unlimited)
dashboard.responderEnabledHint: Respond to DHT queries to help peers discover your indexed content through the BitTorrent DHT network
dashboard.embedTrackersHint: Tracker announce URLs embedded in downloaded .torrent files (one per line)
dashboard.esAddressesHint: Elasticsearch node addresses, one per line
dashboard.embeddingApiKeyHint: Bearer token for the embedding service (e.g. ollama)
dashboard.embeddingModelHint: Model name for embeddings (e.g. bge-m3, nomic-embed-text)
dashboard.embeddingDimensionsHint: Number of embedding dimensions (e.g. 1024 for bge-m3)
dashboard.embeddingInstructionEnabledHint: Prepend an instruction prefix to search queries (required for instruction-tuned models like intfloat/e5-mistral-7b-instruct)
dashboard.hashDiscoverLimitHint: Maximum new info hashes discovered per second
dashboard.kafkaBrokersHint: Kafka broker addresses, one per line
dashboard.llmApiKeyHint: API key for the LLM service
dashboard.llmEnabledHint: Enable AI-powered content classification using a language model
dashboard.llmMaxFilesHint: How many file items from each torrent to send to the LLM for classification. -1 = all files, 0 = title only, N = up to N files
dashboard.llmMaxRetriesHint: Number of automatic retries on API failure
dashboard.llmPromptHint: Shown is the built-in default when no custom prompt is set; edit to customize. Keep the JSON fields (type, base_title, date, languages) unchanged
dashboard.llmPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt
dashboard.llmReasoningEffortHint: Reasoning depth for models that support chain-of-thought
dashboard.llmTemperatureHint: Output randomness (0–2); lower values are more deterministic
dashboard.llmTimeoutHint: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response
dashboard.pgConnectionTimeoutHint: Connection timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout)
dashboard.pgHostHint: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP address
dashboard.pgMaxConnectionsHint: Max connections in the connection pool
dashboard.pgSSLCertPathHint: Path to the client TLS certificate file
dashboard.pgSSLKeyPathHint: Path to the client TLS private key file
dashboard.pgSSLModeHint: SSL/TLS encryption mode for the database connection
dashboard.pgSSLRootCertPathHint: Path to the TLS root CA certificate file
dashboard.queueBackendHint: Message queue backend (memory for single-instance, Kafka for distributed)
dashboard.dimsLockedHint: Locked while a maintenance job is running
dashboard.reindexInProgressHint: Reindex is running; wait for it to finish
dashboard.rescrapeThresholdHint: Seconds before a torrent may be rescraped
dashboard.restartRequired: Requires server restart to take effect
dashboard.searchBackendHint: Full-text search backend (PostgreSQL built-in or Elasticsearch)
dashboard.resumeReindexProgress: Indexed {{indexed}} of {{total}} torrents before the process stopped.
dashboard.resumeReclassifyProgress: Processed {{processed}} of {{total}} torrents before the process stopped.
dashboard.resumeReindexConfigChanged: The embedding configuration has changed since this run started. Continuing resumes from the saved position; already indexed torrents may use the previous configuration.
dashboard.resumeReclassifyConfigChanged: The classifier configuration has changed since this run started. Continuing resumes from the saved position; already reclassified torrents may use the previous configuration.
dashboard.resumePausedByError: The task paused after an error:
dashboard.torrentFilePathHint: Directory where torrent files are stored on disk (e.g. /app/torrents)
dashboard.subtitle: Monitor crawler activity, manage configuration, and inspect the processing queue.
dashboard.title: dashboard
dashboard.fileOutputLevelHint: Log level for file output, or off to disable file logging
dashboard.maxLogFileCountHint: Maximum number of rotated log files to retain (0 = unlimited)
dashboard.maxLogFileSizeHint: Rotate the log file once it reaches this size (0 = unlimited)
dashboard.tmdbAccessTokenHint: Access token for The Movie Database (TMDB)
dashboard.tmdbEnabledHint: Enable metadata lookup via The Movie Database (TMDB)
dashboard.torrentFilterModeHint: Choose whether to process or discard torrents matching the patterns below
dashboard.torrentFilterTitlePatternsHint: Case-insensitive regex patterns matched against torrent titles. One per line.
dashboard.torrentFilterFilenamePatternsHint: Case-insensitive regex patterns matched against each file's full path. One per line.
dashboard.concurrencyHint: Maximum number of concurrent classification jobs
dashboard.torznabEnabledHint: Serve the Torznab API for Servarr apps (Lidarr, Radarr, Sonarr, Readarr) and Prowlarr
dashboard.torznabApiKeyHint: Clients must pass ?apikey= on every request. Empty = no key required
dashboard.torznabMaxResultsHint: Maximum results returned per search request
dashboard.torznabCategoriesHint: Newznab category IDs, one per line. Use * for all categories
dashboard.torznabCategoriesEmpty: Add at least one category or *
dashboard.torznabTrustProxyHeadersHint: Honor X-Forwarded-* when building links; disable when directly exposed
dashboard.webhooksEnabledHint: Send classified torrent events to the configured URLs (JSON POST)
dashboard.webhooksUrlsHint: Endpoints that receive every event, one per line
dashboard.webhooksUrlsEmpty: Add at least one URL when enabled
dashboard.webhooksUrlInvalid: Must be an absolute http(s) URL
dashboard.webhooksEventClassified: classified — after a torrent is classified and stored
dashboard.webhooksMaxRetriesHint: Retries with exponential backoff before an event is dropped
dashboard.webhooksQueueSizeHint: Async delivery queue capacity; when full new events are dropped
dashboard.webhooksBaseUrlHint: Public address of this server; adds a torrent_url download link to the payload (empty = omitted)
dashboard.webhooksHeadersHint: Extra HTTP headers sent with every delivery (e.g. Authorization for authenticated endpoints); masked values are kept on save
dashboard.webhooksHeaderKeyEmpty: Header key is required when a value is set
dashboard.webhooksCategoriesHint: Only send events for the selected content types; none selected = all types
dashboard.webhooksTitleRegexHint: One RE2 pattern per line, case-insensitive; any match passes. Empty = no title filter
dashboard.webhooksFilenameRegexHint: One RE2 pattern per line, case-insensitive, matched against file paths (joined with /); any match passes. Empty = no filename filter
